answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 16578 Country: India Title: during ramzan time for prayers no time to go mosque instead we pray in the work area or we should go to masjid compulsorily. Question: during ramzan time for prayers no time to go mosque instead we pray in the work area or we should go to masjid compulsorily. Answer ID: 16578 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1678/1336/L=1430) Performing salah with jama?ah is sunnah muakkadah, some scholars have called it wajib as well; the reward of congregational salah is 27 times higher than that of individual salah. Therefore, you should not make a habit of missing jama?ah. There is no matter if there is some compelling reason for leaving the jama?ah and performing salah in house. In these cases also, it is better take one two persons and perform salah with congregation so that they can get the reward of jama?ah. It is severe sin to be habitual of missing jama?ah, the hadith gives a stern warning for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
